set.body:
Source: hard architecture assessment of the live multivar and linalg modules on 2026-07-17.

Problem: DualityDiagram is already the correct numerical spine, but its semantic guarantees are incomplete. MvSpace and MvMap enforce identity and direction only at runtime; MvMetric is documented as PSD even though structural construction does not prove PSD; centering is not tied to an explicit row measure; singular geometry silently uses a range pseudoinverse; GenPCA results expose ambiguous ou, ov, u, v, and metricScores names; and paired analyses can establish row identity from equal row counts. There is no language-neutral IR for these guarantees.

Goal: make the duality diagram determine the semantic type layer, safe constructors, generalized-PCA result contract, singularity policy, row relationships, multiset objectives, law tests, and portable descriptors. Build on MatrixView and linalg.LinearMap rather than creating a second numerical backend.

Scope:
1. Law harness and semantic generalized-PCA results.
2. Stable nominal spaces, primal and dual coordinates, directed typed operators, role-specific forms, and retained numerical certificates.
3. Measures, typed centering, singular-support policies, and a composed immutable diagram representation.
4. Exact and partial row maps, row links, hub-factorized entity alignment, relation kinds, and support diagnostics.
5. Block design, association/agreement/constraint problems, and direct-sum compilation with objective-form versus metric distinctions.
6. Versioned language-neutral IR and conformance fixtures.
7. Compatibility migration, documentation, and full cross-platform release gate.

Constitutional qualifications:
- Stable SpaceId is the durable identity; path-dependent types are scoped compile-time evidence produced through an interning registry.
- No-naked-matrix applies at statistical API boundaries, not inside linalg kernels.
- A linked direct-sum operator is a RowGeometry only when positivity is certified; otherwise it is a SymmetricObjectiveForm.
- Diagram semantics are composed subobjects rather than one monolithic constructor.
- Gauge identities and learned alignment estimators are deferred until concrete methods require them.

Non-goals: no new dense matrix family, no Breeze or scheduler types in shared code, no Python or R implementation in this epic, no silent materialization fallback, no automatic conversion among metric, kernel, penalty, covariance, or precision roles, and no implicit positional row alignment.

Completion: all child issues closed; focused multivar JVM and JS suites pass; compileAll and testAll pass; law tests use explicit residual norms and tolerances; docs and module relations describe the final boundary; unsafe assumptions and compatibility shims are visible and auditable.
set.title: EPIC: multivar — typed duality constitution and partial-alignment algebra
